fields.name: Dubstep / 140
fields.description: Heavy, spacious and bass-first. Expect huge low end, half-time rhythms, dark atmosphere and everything from deep, meditative soundsystem music to aggressive wobbling drops.

fields.name: Hard Techno
fields.description: Fast, relentless and built for intensity. This is the kind of music for dark warehouses, pounding kicks, industrial textures and very little downtime.

fields.name: Hard Dance / Hardcore
fields.description: Even more extreme and rave-driven than hard techno. Expect huge kicks, euphoric or chaotic melodies, very high energy and a crowd that came specifically to go hard.

fields.name: Mainstage / Commercial EDM
fields.description: Big, immediate and designed for huge moments. Think festival drops, recognizable hooks, dramatic buildups and music that works just as well for casual listeners as dedicated clubbers.

fields.name: Latin Electronic
fields.description: Electronic club music with strong Latin rhythmic and cultural influence. Expect percussion, swagger, dancefloor energy and styles that can move between house, bass, reggaeton-adjacent sounds and more experimental club music.

fields.name: Drum & Bass
fields.description: Fast, kinetic and addictive. Rapid breakbeats sit over deep basslines, ranging from smooth and emotional liquid DnB to aggressive neurofunk and massive dancefloor anthems.

fields.name: Afro Electronic
fields.description: Warm, rhythmic and deeply groove-focused. Expect rolling percussion, rich basslines and hypnotic repetition, covering everything from amapiano and Afro House to more bass-heavy African club sounds.

fields.name: Breaks / Breakbeat
fields.description: Funky, syncopated and less predictable than four-on-the-floor dance music. The broken drum patterns give it a bouncing, restless energy that can feel playful, gritty or futuristic.

fields.name: Indie Dance
fields.description: Stylish, leftfield club music with a slightly alternative edge. It often blends electronic grooves with disco, synth-pop, post-punk or psychedelic influences and tends to feel cooler and less polished than mainstream dance.

fields.name: Psy-Trance
fields.description: Hypnotic, psychedelic and extremely energetic. Expect rolling basslines, strange sound design, rapid rhythms and a feeling of being pulled into a neon alien tunnel for several hours.

fields.name: Brazilian Funk
fields.description: Raw, rhythmic and built around movement. Heavy percussion, chopped vocals and aggressive grooves give it a street-party energy that can swing from playful to absolutely ferocious.

fields.name: Electro
fields.description: Funky, robotic and retro-futuristic. Expect punchy drum machines, synthetic basslines and a slightly mechanical groove that feels somewhere between old-school futurism and underground club music.

fields.name: Trap / Future Bass
fields.description: Bass-heavy but more dramatic and melodic than dubstep. Trap brings booming drums and swagger, while future bass adds emotional chords, bright synths and huge cinematic drops.

fields.name: UK Garage / Bassline
fields.description: Bouncy, fast and full of swing. Shuffling drums, chopped vocals and elastic basslines make it feel lively, playful and perfect for a packed dancefloor.

fields.name: House
fields.description: Groovy, warm and endlessly danceable. House can be soulful, deep, funky, minimal or driving, but the core feeling is usually smooth four-on-the-floor rhythm and a strong sense of flow.

fields.name: Bass / Club
fields.description: A broad home for modern, rhythm-heavy club music that doesn’t fit neatly elsewhere. Expect unusual drum patterns, heavy low end, global influences and a more experimental, forward-thinking dancefloor vibe.

fields.name: Trance
fields.description: Euphoric, emotional and expansive. Long buildups, soaring melodies and driving rhythms create that classic hands-in-the-air feeling, whether the sound is dreamy, uplifting or more intense.

fields.name: Techno
fields.description: Hypnotic, driving and focused on rhythm and texture. It can be deep and subtle or dark and powerful, but the appeal is usually getting locked into a steady groove and losing track of time.

fields.name: Nu Disco / Disco
fields.description: Funky, glamorous and feel-good. Expect groovy basslines, shiny synths, soulful vocals and a retro dancefloor energy with a modern electronic polish.

fields.name: Dance / Pop
fields.description: Catchy, bright and vocal-forward. This is electronic music built around memorable choruses, polished production and easy crossover between clubs, radio and pop playlists.

fields.name: Ambient / Experimental
fields.description: Atmospheric, strange and often more about immersion than dancing. It can be calm, cinematic, abstract or challenging, making it ideal for listeners who want electronic music that feels more like a world than a beat.

fields.name: Industrial / EBM
fields.description: Dark, mechanical and confrontational. Expect pounding rhythms, cold synths, distorted textures and a gritty underground aesthetic that sits somewhere between electronic body music, industrial and dark club culture.
